decisions.reason: As a straightforward cleaning product embedded in the firm's wood-floor system offer, it draws on existing technical knowledge, customer ties, and aftersales learning, so it is efficient to retain and incrementally improve.

This maintenance-oil line is closely connected to the firm's expertise in wooden floor surfaces and can be refined through installer feedback and in-house R&D, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.

The care line for oiled floors remains strongly related to the firm's established product base and absorptive capacity is high, though some overlap within the care portfolio creates a modest rationalisation risk.

The oak parquet line sits at the core of the firm's wood-processing, design, and flooring capabilities, so management is likely to keep it and use accumulated market knowledge to strengthen the range.
